scope: Five source books only; unchanged application/control/runtime evidence bridged by 268 exact nondata Git blobs. No application, source-builder, test, browser, image, old review or data changes.

method.identityAlignment: Teams/source records by stable id; player games by playerId+gameId; fixture availability by playerId or espnId; QB missing-statistics by playerId+gameId. Exact identity strategies and collision/array receipts retained in detailed artifact.
method.metadataExclusionRule: Only explicitly located provenance/header/digest/refresh timestamps are excluded. Injury, reportStatus, practiceStatus, reportedInactive, officialConfirmed, stat values, roster identities, depth ranks and coverage remain compared. Provider sourceTimestamp chronology is recorded separately, not silently discarded.
method.arrayQualification: Index changes are retained, then identities are aligned. Reordering is reported separately from record membership/fact changes.

partialFixtureAvailability.qualification: ESPN provider-reported partial representations, completeOfficialList false. All added/removed records are Questionable, reportedInactive null, officialConfirmed false. Absence establishes neither recovery, active eligibility nor roster removal. Builder preserves all provider entries/order and applies no local five-record cap.

currentAndTeam.conclusion: current.json contains one consistent betting-line update (three copies); team-details.json has no domain/factual change. All remaining changed values are metadata.
currentAndTeam.identityStrategy: Use id for teams, standings, roster, games and sources; playerId for leaders; gameId for last5 and historical prices; label for stat tiles; field for single-subject issues/unavailable; playerId+week for injury reports; playerId+unit+position for depth records; playerId/team/field or gameId/playerId/team/field for cross-record disagreements. Every chosen key is unique in its array at both commits.

playerHistory.projectionDefinition: Remove only top-level generatedAt/retrievedAt/currentSourceHashes; per-game retrievedAt/scheduleRetrievedAt; per-source retrievedAt/sha256/etag/lastModified. Preserve every other field and all scalar array sequences. Align source records by id.

matchup.ranks: All 210 stored depth ranks, ranking contract and ranking input pool/statistics unchanged; rendered application ranks were not recomputed.
matchup.snapshotContract: schemaVersion=1, season=2026, currentWeek=5, throughWeek=5 and top-level provenance text unchanged.
matchup.sourceContracts: 125 source IDs, URLs, providers, required flags, HTTP statuses, verification/TLS statuses unchanged.

qbMissingStatistics.preservation: All 25 missing-statistics records, notes and source IDs preserved. Twelve uncorroborated and twelve disputed-role records remain. Hash/retrieval refreshes do not create starts/statistics, remove unknown QB slots, choose a provider or substitute older games.

arrayChanges.qualification: The 25 QB missing-statistics identities are retained exactly; 21 positions move. Other sequence changes belong to partial fixture availability reports and future bulletin copies; detailed sequences and membership operations are retained.

matchup.definition: Leaf replace or whole added/removed value counts once. Aligned membership changes are whole identity-record operations, not JSON Patch move counts.

publicSourceConfirmation.qualification: All three strictly verified TLS HTTP 200 bodies were archived after the 807 fetch; their raw hashes differ from recorded 807 source hashes. They independently corroborate the changed total and added/absent ESPN subset identities with current status/injury. They do not replay or prove every raw upstream 807 byte. Removed entries remain merely absent from a partial list; no healthy/active inference. Weekly practice details were compared in saved records and were not independently refetched. Unchanged source/stat bodies were not refetched.

currentHostedEvidence.qualification: Existing closed current-source WPE receipt was read and hash/body bindings independently verified; no new browser or image review by this source audit.

conclusion: Accepted current source refresh: one odds-total fact and a qualified partial-provider membership update; all other saved domain facts unchanged after explicit identity alignment. Three saved validators and canonical/dependency bindings pass. Application controls remain byte-identical across all 268 nondata runtime files; current hosted delivered 273-body receipt is exact. Full raw upstream 807 replay is not claimed.
